# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Describe the type of defect.
3. Describe the size of the defect.
4. Describe the location of the defect, including the lane of travel it is under and its relation to bearings, expansion joints, joints, and utility crossings.
5. Include sketches and/or photographs that identify the location of the defect. Use a camera that will date the pictures to assist in future documentation.
6. Describe repairs that have been completed in the past.
7. Carry this information forward into future reports as required.
8. Explain in the report the initial funding source and previous repair costs related to the problem described.
9. Submit the reports to your bridge management system.
